findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: There is a gap under the emergency exit door right outside of the receiving area. Ensure all gaps around exterior doors are sealed to prevent the entry of pests. Discussed with PIC.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The wood paneling around the walk-in coolers and freezers in the receiving area must be sealed to the units with silicone caulk to allow them to be easily cleaned. Discussed with PIC.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
The back emergency exit door was observed to have a gap along the bottom of the door, allowing sunlight to pass through.  Gaps and openings allow for the entry of pests and rodents.  Ensure the door is fix to close this gap and prevent pest and/or rodent entry.

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Caulk the gap around the floor to wall in the walk-in cooler (there are two of them) to allow for ease with cleaning. This is a repeat violation from the pre-opening.

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
